Ordinance No. 17833 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17833 was amended by Ordinance Nos. 20184 and 20185, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 25, 1989. source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 150 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 150 was established by Ordinance No. 17833, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 18, 1983. Ordinance No. 17833 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17833 was amended by Ordinance Nos. 20184 and 20185, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 25, 1989. Ordinance No. 20184 changed the zoning of a 10.816- acre portion of the Property from PD 150 to a CR-D Community Retail-Dry District. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17833; 20184; 20185; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 150 is established on property generally located along the east line of Midway Road, north of the Texas Power & Light Co. right-of-way. The size of PD 150 is approximately 11.215 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20184; 20185; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-150.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with a city plan commission-approved development plan which is labelled Exhibit 150A. (Ord. Nos. 17833; 20185; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.105.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of a building permit, a final subdivision plat must be approved by the city plan commission and filed with the county clerk’s office in the county in which the Property is located. (Ord. Nos. 17833; 25508)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.106.PERMITTED USES. Uses permitted within this PD are limited to single-family uses, accessory uses, and common open space as shown on the development plan. The maximum number of dwelling units permitted is 90. Structures housing dwelling units may be attached to each other in groups of eight or less. (Ord. Nos. 20185; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.107.SETBACKS. A minimum setback of 15 feet between each group of eight or less attached structures must be provided at the time the Property is platted. (Ord. Nos. 20185; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.108.MAXIMUM HEIGHT. The height of all buildings on the Property is limited to a maximum of 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 17833; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.109.MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE. Lot coverage is limited to a maximum of 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20185; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.110.PARKING. Parking must be provided as required by the Dallas Development Code for the individual uses. All parking lots must be paved according to the requirements of the Dallas Development Code and must be maintained in good condition at all times. A minimum of two parking spaces per dwelling unit must be provided for each lot in Tract II. (Ord. Nos. 17833; 25508)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.111.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. Common open areas in the subdivision within this PD must be maintained by a homeowners’ association. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city attorney’s office, submitted to the city plan commission in conjunction with the platting of the Property, and filed for record in the deed records of Collin County, Texas. (Ord. Nos. 20185; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.112.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development of this property must be in compliance with all other requirements, ordinances, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20185; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.113.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17833; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.114.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17833; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-150.115.ZONING MAP. PD 150 is located on Zoning Map No. AA-6. (Ord. Nos. 17833; 25508)
